== consider rat
> Ann: consider rat
Ann: You consider <ansi fg="mobname">rat</ansi>...
Ann: It is estimated that your chances to kill <ansi fg="mobname">rat</ansi> are <ansi fg="green">Favorable</ansi>
== attack rat, one round
> Ann: attack rat
Ann: You prepare to fight <ansi fg="mobname">rat</ansi>!
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> prepares to fight <ansi fg="mobname">rat</ansi>.
> DoCombat
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> attacks <ansi fg="mobname">rat</ansi> but fails to connect.
Ann: You swing your <ansi fg="item">fists</ansi>, but miss completely!
